description: Embedding models compared on SQuAD and ConditionalQA: the two the endpoint serves. qwen3-vl-embedding-8b (4,096 dimensions, 32,768-token context) needs no cut, since no chunk here is over 1,024 tokens; its queries are sent without the instruction prefix Qwen recommends, as bge-m3's are. The other stages are at the README's baseline: fixed_token chunking, its max_tokens and overlap swept so that compare.py reports each alternative at its best, no augmentation, bge-m3, dense retrieval, no reranking. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/embedding_eval_squad_conditionalqa.json
